title: VideoStreamPlayer: change scen, video will flicker
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.5.stable, 4.5.1.stable
- Not reproducible in: 4.3.stable, 4.4.stable, 4.4.1.stable

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - macOS Monterey (12.7.6) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Apple M1 - Apple M1 (8 threads) - 16.00 GiB memory

### Issue description

When switching scenes, the video in VideoStreamPlayer may flicker, which was not observed in versions prior to Godot 4.5. The specific phenomenon can be seen in the video files in the nearby compressed files.


[flicker video.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22994667/flicker.video.zip)

### Steps to reproduce

page1  script: 
```gdscript
func _ready() -> void:
	videoplayer.set_stream(load(v1))
	videoplayer.play()

func _on_nextpage_button_pressed() -> void:
	get_tree().change_scene_to_file("res://page2.tscn")
```
page2  script: 
```gdscript
func _ready() -> void:
	videoplayer.set_stream(load(v1))
	videoplayer.play()

func _on_nextpage_button_pressed() -> void:
	get_tree().change_scene_to_file("res://page1.tscn")
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[videoswtich_2025-10-20_10-59-46.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22994736/videoswtich_2025-10-20_10-59-46.zip)(Video 1 and Video 2 were not included in the code project attachment)
